name: Disenchant: a natively scaled quest reward yields the disenchant bracket of its scaled item level
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1, CoA.ItemScaling=1, CoA.ItemScaling.Native=1 and CoA.ItemScaling.Native.QuestRewards=1 with ItemStat.dbc in the data directory. Wanted: Hogger 176 rewards Footman Tunic 6085 (green leather chest, item level 13, DisenchantID 1: Strange Dust 10940 or Lesser Magic Essence 10938). A level 30 character with scaling on receives the tunic at the quest's curve level 26; stock green leather chests of item level 26 disenchant with DisenchantID 4 (Soul Dust 11083, Greater Astral Essence 11082 or Large Glimmering Shard 11084, Enchanting 50), so disenchanting the scaled tunic yields one of those. A level 30 character with scaling off receives the authored tunic, which still yields Strange Dust or Lesser Magic Essence. Both enchanters have Enchanting 300. Client tooltips are not tested.

steps.label: The scaled tunic stores the quest's curve level 26
The scaled tunic's disenchant loot window holds one item
The scaled tunic yields an item level 26 material
The unscaled tunic gets no scaling level
The unscaled tunic's disenchant loot window holds one item
The unscaled tunic yields its authored item level 13 material
